action_items: None for these 4 bugs — all fixes verified. Optional cleanup: legacy /app/backend/tests/test_qa_regression.py still asserts old landing message 'Agenda del Pionero API' vs current 'Horizonte Pionero API' (non-blocking, tracked from iteration_3).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:498-505 (request tribu) and 583-590 (decide tribu) correctly mutate state.tribu_tierra[ref_id]; keeps prior checks and toggles approved/status atomically. Good.

TribuTierraModal.setChecked correctly no-ops when approved=true, ensuring checklist lock post-approval. Consider also locking when status='pendiente' to prevent silent divergence with the approval snapshot (currently the code does lock via 'locked = st=="aprobado" || st=="pendiente"' in the Pressable, so behavior is correct, just verify writes: setChecked only blocks on approved, so a pendiente user COULD toggle checkboxes silently if the Pressable were bypassed — minor defensive gap).
PdfViewer uses gview iframe with public URL for web preview. Works, but Google gview has known intermittent limits; consider react-pdf or pdfjs-dist as a longer-term fallback.
server.py PDF_FILES map is minimal and safe against path traversal (fixed keys). Good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://scout-agenda-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Use mobile viewport 390x844. Login testIDs are auth-email / auth-password / auth-submit (not login-*). Navigation testIDs are nav-inicio/nav-patria/nav-bitacora/nav-mas — after login the last-active section persists, so click nav-inicio before searching quick-* cards. Logout button testID is logout-btn (inside 'Más' tab). Admin inbox rows are inbox-item-<id> with inbox-approve-<id>/inbox-reject-<id> buttons; tribu rows carry the label 'Tribu Tierra · <program_name>'. Run backend tests with: `set -a; . frontend/.env; set +a; python -m pytest backend/tests/test_bug_batch_jan2026.py -v -o addopts= --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_N.xml` (the -o addopts= is required because backend/pytest.ini enables xdist which conflicts with session-scoped fixtures used here). Master key ASB-HORIZONTE-2026 is only needed if QA accounts don't exist; they already do.
